source_binding.mechanism: DBSCAN-style density support/noise distinction plus a stricter cross-generation persistence guard

public_sources.claim_used: DBSCAN introduced a density-based notion of clusters designed to distinguish sufficiently dense structure from noise.
DBSCAN uses an eps neighborhood and min_samples threshold for core points; samples that do not join a cluster can be labeled as noise.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No scikit-learn/DBSCAN execution, hosted clustering service, external model, cloud compute, or user execution is used. Public sources supply only density/noise semantics.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Use the predeclared five-field anomaly fingerprint, Hamming-radius <=1 within the same scope_family, and minimum 3 unique terminal UNCLASSIFIED identities. Add the stricter role-local requirement that support span at least two taxonomy generations before a novel-stratum candidate can be sealed.

scope_limit: Constructed finite anomaly trace only. Density under a fixed fingerprint/radius does not prove semantic coherence; poor similarity design can merge distinct regimes or fragment one regime.
unresolved_child: Similarity-metric choice can itself bias taxonomy formation. A later leaf should test metric disagreement/robustness before a novel cluster is allowed to become permanent selection structure.

quota_cost_assessment.repository_transport_note: Repository API is lightweight state/evidence transport only; rate-limit interruption is checkpoint/retryable and API volume is not used as compute.
